answers.purpose: Check a set of design pages for statements that cannot all hold: one extractor per page lists the page rules as structured facts, a script merges them into one register sorted by actor and object, one checker reads only the register and lists the contradictions, and each contradiction goes to the author as a question with both quotes; the skill never edits a page.

phrases: do the pages contradict each other
triggers.disambiguation: Distinct from /init (CLAUDE.md scaffolding). Distinct from editorial, which reviews prose and structure and closes by rewrite: this skill checks the facts the pages state against each other and closes by a question to the author, never a rewrite. Distinct from editorial-triage, which closes review findings, and from /decide, which only puts questions: design-consistency produces the contradictions that /decide then puts.
